normalization_plan.reason: The 'from' parameter is only used within _transfer for validation and fee logic.
The 'to' parameter is only used within _transfer for validation and fee logic.
The 'amount' parameter is the primary input of _transfer fee arithmetic.
tokenAmount is an argument used only by addLiquidity when calling the router.
ethAmount is an argument used only by addLiquidity for the payable router call.
bnbAmountInWei is the sole argument of buyBackTokens used in the router swap.
newWallet is consumed only by updateMarketingWallet when rewriting _taxWallet.marketing.
newWallet is consumed only by updateBuyBackWallet when rewriting _taxWallet.buyback.
newAmount is validated and assigned to swapTokensAtAmount by updateSwapTokensAtAmount.
contractTokenBalance is a temporary local used to decide whether to call swapBack.
The fees local accumulates the computed fee amount within _transfer.
contractBalance is a temporary local inside swapBack used for proportional math.
totalTokensToSwap is a transient sum used only within swapBack distributions.
liquidityTokens is a temporary local derived inside swapBack.
amountToSwapForETH is a temporary local passed to swapTokensForEth.
ethBalance is a transient recipient-side amount computed inside swapBack.
initialETHBalance snapshots the contract balance at the start of swapBack.
path is a locally built router path array used only in swapTokensForEth.
enabled is the single parameter assigned to blacklistEnabled by enableBlacklist.
